conclusion.rationale: This patch introduces multiple confirmed breaking changes: (1) H2HeaderStrictness config directive completely removed -- existing httpd configurations using it will fail startup. (2) Public API functions removed/renamed (h2_util_ignore_header, h2_req_ignore_header, h2_req_ignore_trailer, h2_res_ignore_trailer) -- external modules linking against old symbols will fail. (3) HTTP/2 protocol behavior changed -- nghttp2 RFC9113 validation always disabled, whitespace always stripped instead of rejected. (4) H2_CONF_HEADER_STRICTNESS enum removed from public header, shifting subsequent enum values and breaking ABI. (5) Public macros removed (H2_HD_MATCH_LIT_CS, H2_CREATE_NV_*). All findings confirmed via static source code comparison but runtime coverage testing could not be performed due to build environment limitations.
